headline: Recommends relocating two Glimpse sculptures at Portland International Jetport for parking lot expansion; approves conservation work on Acrobatic Dogs and Hadlock Field sculptures.
summary: Updates covered the Ramwell Square redesign, the Italian legacy project, the fuel box removal, and communications. Members approved conservation work on two sculptures and recommended relocating two Glimpse sculptures for a parking lot expansion.
decisions: Council approved deaccessioning the fuel box artwork on October 5, before this meeting.
Approved conservation work on the Acrobatic Dogs sculpture and the Hadlock Field sculpture; motion passed on roll call.
Recommended relocating two Glimpse sculptures at Portland International Jetport for the parking lot expansion, and retaining a qualified contractor to move them.
discussion: Glimpse sculpture insurance: Members discussed who would insure the two sculptures during the move, and whether the existing $50,000 fine arts coverage would be enough.
Fuel box panels reuse: Members discussed whether the 25 cast iron panels could be reused in another place.
Public art guidelines review: Members agreed the public art guidelines should be reviewed so proposals fit the guidelines and reach more people.
Communications subcommittee chair: Members sought a new chair who could handle social media and fundraising.
December meeting timing: Members weighed whether to hold a December meeting or take a recess, and planned to confirm with new members next month.
